## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One fix is needed before this is consistent with project policy: `--exclude` does not take its default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, so CI cannot set it through the environment as the project's flag rules require.

## Changes
This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag. `collect()` uses it to skip files whose base name matches any of the patterns, and logs each skipped path at INFO. It also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds tests for the parser, for `collect()` and for the end-to-end archive.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default --exclude from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` set and no `--exclude` argument, `.log` files are still archived, because `default=[]` ignores the environment. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI jobs that set options through the environment cannot exclude files, which breaks the project's documented flag contract. — Fix: Build the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")`, choosing and documenting a separator for multiple patterns, then add a case next to `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing` and a row note in `docs/flags.md`.
